# descope_wellknown_settings (Resource)

Manages the project's customization of its OIDC discovery documents. This is a singleton resource, and its id is always the project ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that these settings belong to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `claims_supported` (Attributes) Claims to add to or exclude from `claims_supported`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claims_supported))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Setting this to `true` applies the customization to the project's discovery documents. While `false` the customization is kept but the default documents are served.
- `hidden_fields` (Set of String) Fields to omit from the discovery documents. Hiding a field only stops advertising it, the endpoint or capability itself stays enabled. Supported values are `backchannel_authentication_endpoint`, `pushed_authorization_request_endpoint`, `request_parameter_supported`, `registration_endpoint`, `end_session_endpoint`, `introspection_endpoint`, `device_authorization_endpoint`, `revocation_endpoint`, `userinfo_endpoint` and `backchannel_logout_supported`.
- `removed_values` (Attributes Set) Values to remove from list fields in the discovery documents, such as a grant type from `grant_types_supported`. A list is never emptied, removing every value keeps the full list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--removed_values))
- `scopes_supported` (Attributes) Scopes to add to or exclude from `scopes_supported`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes_supported))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--claims_supported"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claims_supported`

Optional:

- `excluded` (Set of String) Values to remove from the list.
- `extra` (Set of String) Values to add to the list.


<a id="nestedatt--removed_values"></a>
### Nested Schema for `removed_values`

Required:

- `field` (String) The name of a list field in the discovery documents, such as `grant_types_supported`, `token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported` or `code_challenge_methods_supported`.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to remove from the list.


<a id="nestedatt--scopes_supported"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scopes_supported`

Optional:

- `excluded` (Set of String) Values to remove from the list.
- `extra` (Set of String) Values to add to the list.
